paragraphs.body: RB Leipzig boss Martín Demichelis praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League clash against Real Madrid at the Bernabéu, describing the French defender as exceptional despite the daunting nature of the upcoming fixture. The comments were reported by Yahoo, Yardbarker, and OneFootball, who all highlighted Demichelis's high regard for Diomande in the context of the European tie.

headline: Demichelis hails Diomande ahead of Real Madrid clash
